content:
**Perfect mothman eggs** are consumable items in *Fallout 76*.

They can be consumed raw to satisfy a small amount of hunger with a very high dose of radiation and a high disease chance, or cooked for additional benefits.

When affected by a Blast Zone, perfect mothman eggs will mutate into Ionized Crackleberry which yields Raw Crimson Flux when harvested.

During the collection phase of Event: The Mothman Equinox, players may deposit perfect mothman eggs into the Cradle of the Pretenders. Doing so will replace the vengeful mothmen with mothmen hatchlings during the defense phase. [1] 

In an earlier version of Event: The Mothman Equinox, players would harvested Enlightened Mothman Egg during the collection phase. A number of these eggs would have been deposited into the Cradle of the Pretenders located behind the Mothman Museum statue. Although clutches would have held purple eggs, they yielded perfect mothman eggs which are black. [2] 

 Perfect mothman eggs do not use their custom purple reskin. [3]
